verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs describe dashboards and reporting, collaboration through shared views and permissions, and fine-grained data access rights that control who can see and modify specific data. Together these point to scoped sharing of reports, but the evidence comes from index-level mentions and never describes the dashboard-sharing workflow itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sharing a dashboard or report with specific recipients, sharing with external or board-level viewers (e.g. view-only guest access), detail on how permissions apply to shared boards, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share dashboards and reports with the board or team under scoped access

citations.quote: collaborate effectively in Pigment with shared views, comments, permissions, and notifications
fine-grained data access rights for all data within your Pigment applications, allowing you to determine who can see and modify specific data
turn data into insights with Pigment's reporting tools, visualization tips, and expert advice on building clear, compelling dashboards
